summary: Q1 2026 reported May 19, 2026. Earnings catalysts: (1) L3 autonomy industry transition driving higher sensor content per vehicle; (2) Mercedes-Benz strategic supplier agreement for L3 lidar covering Europe + China, with Thailand manufacturing; (3) Q1 revenue +30% YoY to $99M with core business operating profitability; (4) Backlog exceeds 6 million units, new design wins in automotive + robotics; (5) New product launches Picasso 6D SPAD-SoC and Kosmo spatial intelligence device — shift toward higher-margin software/data; (6) Q2 2026 guidance RMB850-900M (+20-27% YoY). Next quarterly earnings (Q2 2026) expected mid-August 2026 (no exact date confirmed).
